name: genudo
description: Genudo — the enterprise operating platform for autonomous AI Employees: Aaref (Sales), Adnan (Customer Support), ROZ (Quality Control & Operations), and Sara (WhatsApp Campaign Sender) across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and Web.
